fire: Rangers warn visitors not to carry off pieces of petrified wood from the desert floor.

The cliff above the river is famous for petroglyphs left by hunters long ago.
quiet: Rangers warn visitors not to carry off pieces of driftwood from the lake shore.
A short trail leads to a meadow covered in wildflowers and grazing sheep.
The treaty was recorded in a ledger of thick cream paper.
The storm left huge branches scattered on the lawns above the lake.
